about: A tool that opens large archives like TAR, ZIP and RAR as a normal folder.

prs.title: Files in mounted ZIPs show the right times
prs.broken: Files inside a mounted ZIP showed times shifted by the local time zone, hours off from what unzip shows.
prs.changed: I made it read the time as local, or use the UTC time stored in the file when there is one.
prs.matters: File times in a mounted ZIP match the real ones.
